SEARCH
Package domain

Class Player

java.lang.Object
domain.Entity
domain.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Player extends Entity
A player on the field: a character controlled by a person or by the machine, with the stats of its profile. It runs, jumps and kicks; it has life, a power bar that fills in 10 seconds and an aura when its power is active. It can have one effect of a power shot (a new one replaces the old one) and, apart from it, the stun.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda

  • Method Details

    • act

      public void act(Match match)
      Asks the controller for this tick's actions and executes them. If the player cannot act (stunned, pushed, unconscious) it does nothing and the physics carries it.
      Parameters:
      match - the match being played

    • update

      public void update(double dt)
      Fills the power bar (also while the aura is on), counts down the kick, the effect and the stun. When the stun is over the life goes back to the maximum.
      Parameters:
      dt - elapsed time, in seconds

    • moveLeft

      public void moveLeft()
      Runs left.

    • moveRight

      public void moveRight()
      Runs right.

    • stop

      public void stop()
      Stops running; the vertical movement does not change.

    • jump

      public void jump()
      Jumps. It only works on the ground and if the effect allows it.

    • kick

      public void kick(Match match)
      Kicks. If the ball is within the reach of the foot it leaves towards the rival goal (or the power shot comes out, if the aura is on). If the rival is within reach it takes KICK_DAMAGE times the kick multiplier.
      Parameters:
      match - the match being played

    • activatePower

      public void activatePower()
      Activates the power: with a full bar and no aura, the bar goes to 0 (and starts filling again) and the aura appears. It has no time limit.

    • useAura

      public void useAura()
